title: TopCashback AU - Missing Cashback Claim - How Long?
body:
Has anybody had experience with claiming a missing cashback from TCB?
I’ve done it before with SB and it’s been sorted within two months at most.
But I reported a missing cashback with TCB in January and it’s still ongoing. Every time I follow up I get the same response that they’ll be in touch when they hear from the retailer.
Do they not actually chase it up? At least once the 90 days have passed you’d think they’d actively chase it but none of the replies seem to indicate they do.
How long do these drag on normally with TCB?
UPDATE: Finally received an update where TCB say they chased up the retailer and…..Rejected. With a very unhelpful “refer to the terms to work out why”
I’ll be sticking with ShopBack I guess
